paite: TOUPA ka suangpi phat in om hen, ama'n ka khutte galdou azilsak a, ka khutzungte dou ding in achil hi.
heading: David La / Pathian Kiang A Kumpipa Kipahthu Genna

paite: Ka zahngaihna leh ka kulhpi, ka insang leh hon humbitpa, ka phaw leh ka muanna kingakna ka nuai a ka mite zou zelpa ahi.
TOUPA mihing bang ahia, hichi tel a amah na theih naknak? Mihing tapa leng kua ahia ahih, na ngaihtuah naknak?
Mihing zaw bangmah lou lel ahi a; adamsung nite lim mang zel bang ahi.
TOUPA aw, na vante kunsak in hong paisuk inla; tangte khoih in, huchi in akhukhe ding uhi.
Khua phesak inla, amau dalhsak in na thalte kapkhia inla, hihbuaigawp in.
Tunglam a kipan in na khut in hon sawk inla; tui lian a kipan in hon honkhia in.
Akam un bangmah lou agen ua, akhut taklam uh diklouhna khut taklam ahi.
Pathian aw, nangmah pahtawi in la thak ka sa ding a; pekging gui sawm nei in nangmah phat in la ka sa ding hi.
Amah ahi, kumpipate kiang a hotdamna pia a, namsau mi hihse thei lak a asikha David hunkhepa pen.
Hon honkhia inla, mikhualte khut a kipan hon humbit in, akam un thu bangmah lou peuh agen nak ua, akhut taklam uh khut taklam diklou ahi.
Ka tate uh ahong valnou ua singnou dipdip bang a a-om ua; ka tanute uh leng inpi omdan gel bang a aning a suangkhuak bang a a-om hun un;
Ka buh innte uh adim a, thil chi chih a-om phetphut a; ka belamte un leng nou asang asang a tam, asing asing a tam ka mun ua aneih chiang un;
Ka bawngte uh ahong suan phat a; nou neihsiat himhim a-om louh a; insung lok leh pawtkhia a-om louh a, ka kongzingte ua kikou husa a-om louh chiang in.
Huchibang a om mite kipaktak in a-om nak uhi; ahi, TOUPA Pathian anei mite kipaktak in a-om nak uhi.
